producer_report.summary: The root cause was that the planning stage derived landing, history and attribution rules from the happy-path commit shape. It did not use the full set of shapes the system produces, and it demonstrated the rules on a fixture without them. The fix is in the planner and critic prompts. planner.md now requires an enumerated commit-shape table with the rule's outcome for each shape. It also requires demonstrations on a realistic-branch fixture (an intervention commit, a records-only commit and the job landing) and the tests of every crate that calls the changed classification functions. critic.md has a new checklist item that raises a major finding when any of these is missing. A new test in athena-context pins the wording in both prompts. I raised the local 700-token frame-size bound to 900. I updated the planner and critic budget lines in docs/system-facts.md to 1175 and 992, because the budgets test requires it. CHANGELOG.md records the root cause, the class and the three introspections. The code of the three earlier jobs is untouched. I ran the athena-context tests, the budgets, policy and mirrors tests, fmt, clippy on athena-context, and `cargo test --locked` once. All showed passes.
